calibration.method: Bounded step adjustment of a per-pond demand multiplier (0.8-1.25). Stress observed after a safe/watch forecast nudges it up (+0.05/+0.03); no stress after a watch/danger forecast nudges it down (-0.01/-0.02). Nights with aerators running, or not checked, cause no change.
calibration.limitations: Farmer observations are qualitative and do not measure dissolved oxygen. This demo adjustment is not statistical calibration, is not validated, and never retrains any model automatically.

events.explanation: Stress was reported after a watch forecast; demand multiplier nudged up.
